payload.comment: Profiling stage is clean and internally consistent. Key checks: (1) Archive integrity verified — MD5 a8b0696529087d5bd730944a56c1 matches verified_archive_md5; SHA256 present. (2) Split sizes (train=89996, val=10004, test=7180) match official sizes exactly; no subsampling. (3) Image shape 28×28×3 RGB is consistent with the standard MedMNIST distribution. (4) 9-class multi-class task confirmed by manifest; class proportions between train and val are nearly identical (max absolute deviation < 0.0001), indicating no split-level distribution shift. (5) Imbalance ratio 1.63 is modest; no class is under-represented to a degree requiring special handling. (6) Zero blank images, zero duplicate train samples. (7) Channel statistics (means ≈ [0.74, 0.53, 0.71], stds ≈ [0.12, 0.18, 0.12]) are plausible for H&E-stained histology patches. (8) Run manifest pins all package versions, code SHA256, seed 72, and enables deterministic torch. (9) Test-domain note (CRC-VAL-HE-7K, different clinical center) is properly recorded for OOD awareness. Minor observations: the ingestion comment refers to the task as 'multi-label' while the manifest correctly states 'multi-class' — a wording inconsistency with no functional impact. The llm_model_digest for qwen3.8 is null, a traceability gap already flagged in ingestion; it does not affect data or model correctness. No deterministic findings are present. The stage is ready to proceed to the next phase.
